name: The exploded record
reader_question: What must remain attached when knowledge enters a task?
visual_idea: An exploded object separates meaning, scope and provenance while preserving one identity, beside the review boundary.
why_geometry_helps: An exploded object separates meaning, scope and provenance while preserving one identity, beside the review boundary.
interaction_if_any: Native labelled controls expose the relevant object or consequence; no hover dependency.
false_inference_risk: Vertical depth may imply maturity or approval; the caption defines the three planes as attached record parts. The actual source remains one version.
references_used: Supplied Design Board-8: simultaneous source, interpretation and responsibility
Supplied Design System-15: material distinction, authored scale and quiet chrome
what_is_deliberately_not_shown: Detailed chapter text and actual enterprise readiness.
